purpose: Teach: 快速/鶴岡/マシーン/ドミノ/フロンティア/アジアン/ロッキー/マーラー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、快速電車で通勤されるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer mentioned she takes the express train to work, didn't she?
lines.style: Soft, musing tone. A quiet observation offered gently, like sharing something small you noticed about someone. Warm curiosity without prying.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、鶴岡八幡宮に参拝されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and she said she visited Tsurugaoka Shrine recently.
lines.style: Mild surprise in the voice. Piecing together the picture of this person. Thoughtful pause before speaking, like remembering something kind about them.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コーヒーマシーンの最新型を購入されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Hmm, she bought one of those new coffee machines, I think.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself. A small detail that lodges in the memory. Gentle amazement at how much you can learn about someone over time.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ドミノ・ピザがお気に入りだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She really does love Domino's pizza, doesn't she.
lines.style: Warm affection in the delivery. A small, genuine laugh underneath—the fondness of knowing someone's quiet preferences. Settling into the fact of it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アメリカのフロンティア精神を語ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she was talking about the American frontier spirit, remember?
lines.style: A little wonder in the voice. Leaning back slightly, seeing the person more fully for having shared that particular thought. No judgment—just genuine interest.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アジアン料理が大好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She loves Asian cuisine, she mentioned that too.
lines.style: Nodding tone. Building the mosaic of who this person is, piece by piece. Warm and unhurried, like settling in with a memory that makes you smile.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ロッキー山脈に登山されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She's climbed the Rocky Mountains, I think she said.
lines.style: Quiet respect underneath. A moment of seeing the scope of someone's life—their adventures, their reach. Gentle appreciation without fanfare.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、マーラーの交響曲を聴いてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she listens to Mahler symphonies.
lines.style: Trailing off softly, like the last note of something beautiful. A tender, almost wistful closing. The kind of detail that makes you see someone more deeply. Breath of quiet awe.
